Ecological_Synthesis: Core plots generally support denser-wood assemblages, whereas Transition plots tend toward lower community-weighted wood density; the magnitude of this shift depends on habitat.
Transition plots have the highest community-weighted SLA, Buffer plots are intermediate, and Core plots have the lowest SLA.
Community-weighted Seed Mass varies contextually across the Habitat × Zone design, including especially large values in Upland Transition communities.
Maximum Height varies through Habitat × Zone structure, with Upland Transition communities showing an important short-stature contrast.
